internal-jira._comment: Path to the built internal-jira-mcp server. Set INTERNAL_JIRA_MCP_PATH in your shell env (see scripts/setup-claude.sh).

figma-desktop._comment: Figma LOCAL Dev Mode MCP (desktop app) — FALLBACK, user-assisted. No remote quota, but reads ONLY the CURRENT SELECTION (cannot navigate/search). Used when the remote is unreachable/exhausted or for a high-fidelity single-frame render; the agent prompts the dev to select the frame. Requires the desktop app running with Dev Mode + 'Enable desktop MCP server'. See .agentic/rules/_shared/figma-usage.md

figma._comment: Figma Remote MCP — PRIMARY (navigable). URL/node-id navigation across pages + search_design_system + get_metadata/get_screenshot/get_variable_defs. Workable quota on a paid Dev/Full seat (Pro+ ~200/day); apply cache + fetch-once + backoff. OAuth on first use. See https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/32132100833559

aws-mcp._comment: AWS Agent Toolkit — managed remote MCP (Frankfurt, eu-central-1). READ-ONLY governed AWS surface + current AWS docs/skills; SigV4-signed from ~/.aws via the local uvx proxy. Profile conflead-readonly assumes acct 527165097939 role/ai-readonly (ReadOnlyAccess); agent can't reach the admin source profile. Does NOT run terragrunt — IaC stays validate/plan in build-check. Needs `aws sso login --sso-session G-ConfLeadApp` first. See .agentic/rules/iaac/aws-credentials.md
